# vendor

Third-party browser assets, pinned and served from this origin rather than a CDN
(docs/architecture.md §1).

| File | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axe.min.js` | 4.10.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/axe-core@4.10.2/axe.min.js | MPL-2.0 |

axe-core is used only by the accessibility tests. It is not loaded by the
application page.
